_readme.what: Read-only baseline: every structure_set exactly as the mods (or vanilla) define it, with no override. Rebuilt by python3 tools/gen_structure_config.py; do not edit. Spawn rates live in structure_groups.json (groups + standalone sets), membership in the group/* tags of structure_tags.json. kubejs/server_scripts/worldgen/structure_overrides.js reads all three at every world load.

top_level_fields.source: Where this structure_set's definition came from: a mod jar filename, "kubejs/data", or "vanilla_known_defaults" (see caveat below).
top_level_fields.structures: The structure(s) this set places: "structure" (id), "weight", "biomes" (read-only reference) and, when another mod stops it in code, "blocked".
top_level_fields.original: The set's placement without any override. A standalone entry in structure_groups.json overrides individual fields of it.

_readme.meta_structures: Our own structures that have no set of their own and only generate through a group (kubejs/data/creativeengineering/worldgen/structure/meta/). Empty until the first one exists.

placement_dials (inside original).type: Which placement algorithm: "minecraft:random_spread" (almost everything -- an evenly-spaced grid, one random attempt per cell) or "minecraft:concentric_rings" (strongholds only -- rings expanding out from world spawn, not a grid).
placement_dials (inside original).spacing: [random_spread] Chunks between grid cells, i.e. between attempts. Bigger = rarer.
placement_dials (inside original).separation: [random_spread] Minimum chunks between two attempts. Smaller than spacing.
placement_dials (inside original).spread_type: [random_spread, optional] "linear" (default) or "triangular" (biased toward the cell center; vanilla uses it for ocean monuments).
placement_dials (inside original).distance / spread / count: [concentric_rings] ring distance, jitter, and total attempts.
placement_dials (inside original).frequency: A 0.0-1.0 chance per attempt on top of the grid. 0 disables the set.
placement_dials (inside original).salt: Seeds this set's own slice of the world seed's RNG (where on the grid, not how often).
placement_dials (inside original).locate_offset: An integer [x, y, z] nudge of every attempt. Default [0, 0, 0].
placement_dials (inside original).exclusion_zone: Skip attempts within chunk_count chunks of another set's grid attempts (checks attempts, not real structures, and no biome).

_readme.caveats: Vanilla "source":"vanilla_known_defaults" entries come from a table in the scanner (vanilla bootstraps them in Java, unlike every mod here), javap-checked against the 1.19.2 StructureSets bytecode. /dumpstructuregen in-world shows the live values. Also: this pack's minecraft:villages and minecraft:end_cities are NOT vanilla -- Terralith and Nullscape already override them, and the scanner picked that up (check "source" per entry).

structures.blocked: YUNG's Better Dungeons stops it in code (config/betterdungeons-forge-1_19.toml: "Enable Small Nether Dungeons" = false). Tuning this set has no effect.
YUNG's Better Desert Temples stops it in code (config/betterdeserttemples-forge-1_19.toml: "Disable Vanilla Pyramids" = true). Tuning this set has no effect.
YUNG's Better Jungle Temples stops it in code (config/betterjungletemples-forge-1_19_2.toml: "Disable Vanilla Jungle Temples" = true). Tuning this set has no effect.
YUNG's Better Nether Fortresses stops it in code (config/betterfortresses-forge-1_19.toml: "Disable Vanilla Nether Fortresses" = true). Tuning this set has no effect.
YUNG's Better Strongholds always stops it (no config option). Tuning this set has no effect.
YUNG's Better Witch Huts stops it in code (config/betterwitchhuts-forge-1_19.toml: "Disable Vanilla Witch Huts" = true). Tuning this set has no effect.
